claims.quote: Microdevario gatesi is a miniature cyprinid from the lower Irrawaddy basin in Myanmar, growing to around 23 mm SL.
Known only from the lower Irrawaddy River basin in Myanmar, including the Sittaung and Bago tributary drainages, and is possibly endemic to the Irrawaddy Delta region.
